verdicts.reason: Both keep the original's three-column left-to-right structure, which suits the leaderboard banner. In both, the stained-glass window shrinks to a small icon with large empty gaps on either side, and the event details are tiny at this size. A's headline and details are slightly larger and easier to read, though the headline sits close to the top edge. In B, the text is smaller and the window nearly touches the bottom edge, so the date and address are harder to read.
